'''Remote scout modules''' were used by [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] flagship the [[Vendetta (Xizor)|''Vendetta'']] to discreetly investigate the area surrounding the [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. These modules were used around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] to locate [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] ship [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] coming out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
